# ThriveIN

> ThriveIN is the Creative OS — a professional platform where creatives, content creators, and crews search their name, claim verified credits, get matched to gigs, manage projects, and get paid.

ThriveIN combines the best of LinkedIn, IMDb, Behance, Upwork, Fiverr, Slack, Notion, and Trello — purpose-built for the creator economy. Members build a verified career record (ThriveCredits), match with collaborators (Smart Match), discover real gigs (Smart Gig Scout), run projects in collaborative workspaces (ThriveDesk), and invoice clients (ThrivePay).
